verdict.rationale: Sentry documents ingesting OpenTelemetry traces and logs through OTLP endpoints, a Trace Explorer for querying span data, and dashboards that combine error and performance data across projects. That covers traces and logs in one platform, but the evidence never shows metrics collection and never documents pivoting between signals with shared context such as trace-to-log correlation. Missing for 10: explicit metrics ingestion/support, documented cross-signal pivoting with shared context (e.g., logs linked to traces), independent hands-on corroboration.
